### CVE-2024-21755
- Assigner: fortinet | Published: 2024-04-09 | Updated: 2026-01-14 | Max CVSS: 8.6
- CWE: CWE-78 Execute unauthorized code or commands
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 8.6 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H/E:F/RL:X/RC:C`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=total

A improper neutralization of special elements used in an os command ('os command injection') vulnerability in Fortinet FortiSandbox 4.4.0 through 4.4.3, FortiSandbox 4.2.1 through 4.2.6, FortiSandbox 4.0.0 through 4.0.4 allows attacker to execute unauthorized code or commands via crafted requests..

**solutions:** Fortinet remediated this issue in FortiSandbox Cloud version 24.1 and hence customers do not need to perform any action.
Upgrade to FortiSandbox version 4.4.4 or above
Upgrade to FortiSandbox version 4.2.7 or above
Upgrade to FortiSandbox version 4.0.5 or above

Affected:
- Fortinet / FortiSandbox: affected 4.4.0 <=4.4.3 (semver); affected 4.2.1 <=4.2.6 (semver); affected 4.0.0 <=4.0.4 (semver)
- fortinet / fortisandbox: affected 4.0.0 <=4.0.4 (custom); affected 4.2.0 <=4.2.6 (custom); affected 4.4.0 <=4.4.3 (custom)

References:
- https://fortiguard.com/psirt/FG-IR-23-489
